ARNAB KUMAR KAR Contact details-: 8984243788 | AI-Powered Business Analyst | QA Test Lead | Payments & BFSI ISO20022 | SWIFT MT/MX | CBPR+ | BRD/FSD | Stakeholder Management | Process Analysis | UAT
P R O F E S S I O N A L S U M M A R Y AI-Powered Business Analyst with 11+ years of experience in Payments and BFSI transformation. specializing in ISO20022, SWIFT MT/MX, CBPR+, cross-border payments, requirement elicitation, BRD/FSD authoring, stakeholder management, and end- to-end delivery. Strong exposure to real-time and cross-border payment initiatives, gap analysis, process mapping, data mapping, UAT/SIT support, and regulatory change implementation. Experienced in Agile and Waterfall delivery, with hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, SQL, Excel, Power BI, TOSCA, Postman, and Selenium. Completed a Master's Program in AI-Powered Business Analysis from Simplilearn in collaboration with IBM, gaining hands-on experience in AI-assisted analytics, Power BI, and agile delivery. CBPA-certified with a track record of bridging business and technology across HSBC, CIBC, Standard Chartered, and Citi.
